newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Purneftegaz asks Yeltsin to decide on owner.
newsitem.headline: Russia Purneftegaz asks Yeltsin to decide on owner.

text.p: Russia's AO Purneftegaz appealed to President Boris Yeltsin to settle a long-standing row between oil groups Rosneft and SIDANKO over who owns it, a company official said on Monday.

Last month an appeal court suspended an earlier ruling that awarded the production unit to vertically integrated SIDANKO, in the latest round of a battle between it and Rosneft that has lasted over a year.

"The Purneftegaz board appealed to the president with a plea to put an end to the wave of totally pointless, purely tactical court suits with some sort of decision," Rosneft spokesman Valdimir Vyunitsky told Reuters.
He said the next Supreme Court sitting would take place on August 15, although he did not expect it to be the last one.
Last week Deputy Prime Minister Alfred Kokh said his sympathy was with Rosneft, which is going under the hammer in a special cash auction for 51 percent of the company, probably in September.
The government transferred OAO Purneftegaz to state-owned Rosneft in January 1995 as part of a restructuring of the oil industry, having originally allocated it to SIDANKO.
Several courts have since confirmed Rostneft's ownership.
